maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is mainly consumer subscriptions to Norton, Avast and LifeLock security and identity protection, not repair or servicing of installed assets.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are consumers and employers buying Norton, LifeLock and MoneyLion subscriptions and benefits; government is not the payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through subscriptions and cross-selling Norton, Avast, LifeLock; acquisitions (Avast, MoneyLion) are occasional large deals.

mission_critical.reason: Consumer security and identity subscriptions can be switched to competitors or built-in tools without major disruption, though some switching friction exists.

notes: Switching difficulty is borderline; consumer antivirus is easily replaced, so I answered no.
